Task: prepare the live-mode model configuration for an OpenAI-compatible provider other than the hackathon gateway (Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, base URL https://api.anthropic.com/v1/, model id claude-haiku-4-5-20251001). Part 1 is a read-only investigation, part 2 is a small change. Never read .env or print environment variables or keys; no network or database calls; do not run anything that uses a key.
Part 1: read src/core/agent/gateway-client.ts, llm.ts, types.ts (LlmCostSummary), src/core/types.ts (RunConfig, DEFAULT_RUN_CONFIG) and scripts/run-pipeline.ts. Answer in your report: (a) which request fields the gateway client sends (temperature, max_tokens, response_format, user, metadata, extra headers) and which of them Anthropic's compatibility layer ignores or rejects (it ignores response_format, metadata and user; temperature must be between 0 and 1 and is rejected for non-default values only on Claude 4.7 and later models, and claude-haiku-4-5 is older); (b) how cost is determined when the gateway's cost header is absent: is there a fallback rate table, which model names does it know, and what happens for an unknown model name (estimated or unavailable); (c) how the model is selected (RunConfig.model) and where DEFAULT_RUN_CONFIG.model is set; (d) the exact command line, environment variable names and flags to run scripts/run-pipeline.ts so that it runs the IMPROVED pipeline on the FIXTURE provider with a REAL model through a different base URL and model name, with tracing OFF, writing only to the local runs folder and NOT touching evidence/summary.json (do not run it).
Part 2: touch ONLY src/server/live/config.ts, src/server/live/run-live.ts and tests/live/run-live.test.ts (and tests/live/handlers.test.ts only if a type change forces it). Add an OPTIONAL environment variable LIVE_LLM_MODEL, read in readLiveConfig (the same single place that reads the others): when present it is carried in LiveKeys as llmModel, validated as 1 to 64 characters from [A-Za-z0-9._:/-] only, and an invalid value counts as invalid configuration (names only in the missing list), which makes live deps unavailable; when absent, the model stays LIVE_RUN_CONFIG.model. runLiveMode must build the pipeline RunConfig with that model and pass the same string as ctx.model to toResults. Tests: the model from LIVE_LLM_MODEL reaches the pipeline config and ctx.model; an absent variable keeps the old default; an invalid value makes live deps unavailable (a live code then gets 503 live_disabled and the run is released).
Run npx vitest run, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint and npm run build. End with a plain-text SHORT REVIEW REPORT (under 35 lines, no code fences, no secrets): the answers (a) to (d), what changed in part 2, the new test names, the four results as one line each, and anything you were unsure about.
</pasted_content id="4c25">

content.text:
SHORT REVIEW REPORT

Part 1 (read-only)
(a) The gateway client sends only these fields (openai-llm.ts, `send()`): model, messages (role and content), max_tokens and temperature. It sends no response_format, user, metadata or extra headers. The request fields, including the system messages, are sent as built.
- max_tokens is 1500 (RunConfig.max_output_tokens_per_call). temperature is always 0 (LLM_TEMPERATURE).
- Anthropic's layer should accept all of these for claude-haiku-4-5. Temperature 0 is in range, and the ignored fields (response_format, metadata, user) are never sent.
- The client sends the usual OpenAI SDK auth header with the key, plus SDK default headers. I did not check how Anthropic's endpoint treats that auth header. maxRetries is 0 and our adapter owns the retries.

(b) With no x-litellm-response-cost header, cost falls back to an estimate from token usage.
- There is no rate table and no model-name lookup. There are two flat rates for every model: $1.10 per million input tokens and $5.50 per million output tokens (llm-policy.ts). The result is labelled "estimated".
- If usage is also missing, the cost is "unavailable". An unknown model name is still estimated at the flat rates.
- For claude-haiku-4-5 the flat rates are probably wrong, so the estimate would be an approximation. Anthropic returns no cost header.

(c) The model comes from RunConfig.model, and every LlmRequest uses it. DEFAULT_RUN_CONFIG.model is "claude-haiku" (src/core/types.ts:255). DEV_RUN_CONFIG and LIVE_RUN_CONFIG also hard-code "claude-haiku". run-pipeline.ts builds its config from DEFAULT_RUN_CONFIG (eval) or DEV_RUN_CONFIG.

(d) The script cannot do this today, with no code change.
- buildLlm calls createGatewayLlmClient({ apiKey }) with no baseURL, so it always uses the LiteLLM gateway URL. It reads only LITELLM_API_KEY.
- There is no flag or environment variable for the model name or the base URL, and the model is fixed to "claude-haiku".
- The flags that do exist: `--pipeline improved --provider fixture --llm real --confirm-spend --trace off --label <name> [--config dev|eval]`. The key is read from LITELLM_API_KEY.
- The full command would be: `LITELLM_API_KEY=<key> npx tsx scripts/run-pipeline.ts --pipeline improved --provider fixture --llm real --confirm-spend --trace off --label haiku45`. As it stands this would hit the old gateway with model "claude-haiku".
- It writes only runs/<timestamp>-<label>.json. Nothing in the script touches evidence/summary.json.
- To make it work, the script needs a base-URL env var and a model flag. That change was outside part 2.

Part 2
- config.ts: LiveKeys gets an optional llmModel. readLiveConfig reads LIVE_LLM_MODEL and validates it against `^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{1,64}$`. An invalid value pushes "LIVE_LLM_MODEL" (the name only) onto missingLiveKeys and sets live to null.
- run-live.ts: runLiveMode builds `{ ...LIVE_RUN_CONFIG, model: llmModel ?? LIVE_RUN_CONFIG.model }`. It passes that config to the pipeline and uses the same model string as ctx.model.
- Real-mode createLlm and the base URL are unchanged.

New tests (describe "runLive: LIVE_LLM_MODEL" in run-live.test.ts)
- passes the model from LIVE_LLM_MODEL to the pipeline config and to ctx.model
- keeps the default model when LIVE_LLM_MODEL is absent
- an it.each over 6 values: "", "   ", "bad model", 65 characters, "model;rm" and "modèle". The last 5 make live deps unavailable. Each gets 503 live_disabled, and the run is released.

Results
- vitest: 749 passed, 6 skipped, none failed.
- tsc --noEmit: clean.
- lint: clean.
- build: succeeded.

Unsure about
- A set-but-blank LIVE_LLM_MODEL (empty or whitespace) is treated as absent. This follows the existing present() rule, and you may prefer it to count as invalid.
- The pipeline test checks the model through the FakeLlm request and run.config.model. I did not spy on runImprovedPipeline itself.
- Whether Anthropic's endpoint accepts the SDK's default auth header.
